nos.resposta_alvo: I have a reservation under the name Silva.

nos.fala_ia: The room rate is 90 pounds per night, breakfast included. Shall I proceed with the reservation?
nos.dica_pt: Confirme que o preço está bom e peça para continuar.

nos.fala_ia: Thank you. Your room is on the third floor, room 305. Do you need help with your luggage?
nos.resposta_alvo: No, thank you, I can manage.
alternativas_aceitas: Yes, that would be great, thank you.

alternativas_aceitas: When do I need to check out?

nos.fala_ia: No problem, I'll call a porter to help you with your bags.
Check-out time is at 11 AM. Would you like a wake-up call?

nos.fala_ia: Understood. Is there anything else I can help you with tonight?
nos.resposta_alvo: Actually, could you recommend a good restaurant nearby?
alternativas_aceitas: Yes, do you know any good restaurants around here?

You're welcome. Enjoy your stay at the Riverside Hotel!
